answer: The lotus schedule is applied in sonnet and umber shows each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1263 identities would post 1251 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
